_about: Filing-deadline calendar for fetch_deadlines.py and fetch_election.py. 'calendar' entries print as 'Coming due' notes in the matching edition (AM only) during the 14 days before 'date'. 'fec_checks' run after their due date (+1 day grace) for up to 'check_days' days, listing sitting members whose principal campaign committee has no report of that type on file. 'pfd_annual' drives the House/Senate missing/late annual-report checks. Statutory dates for the 2026 cycle; update each cycle.
